operator-walkthrough.ref: Final aggregate diff (server + client). apps/nickstire/client/src/pages/admin/OpportunitiesSection.tsx: each row has Called, Texted and Not a customer (Not relevant on scheduled / walk_in_expected / arrived rows, writing the neutral note) on opportunityQueue.transition; every transition sends from: the rendered state and the server refuses with { ok: false } when the row changed under the crew; Not a customer asks first through the house confirmDialog; a failed save (thrown error, the mutation's { ok: false } refusal, or an offline tap, since the mutation runs with networkMode always) puts the row back and shows a sonner toast in plain words; rows show type, age in days from SQL (DATEDIFF in America/New_York), the last attempt read back from the receipts, 'No attempt recorded here' plus 'Automated texts sent: N' when the collector recorded them, a plain-text phone (no tap-to-call when the opt-out flag is set, since the flag cannot tell a text opt-out from do-not-contact), and 'Reply from Messages' instead of verbs on human_pending_sms rows; untouched rows first then newest, ordered on the server before the 500 limit (order: 'worklist' input), with a banner that says older rows may exist. apps/nickstire/client/src/pages/admin/outreach/WaitingOnUs.tsx: the Messages header shows smsConversations.humanPendingSummary (count, measured zero, or unknown on error or paused) instead of the unreadCount sum. Server: transitionOpportunity appends the receipt atomically in one UPDATE (JSON_ARRAY_APPEND) pinned to id and state; opportunityQueue.list returns ageDays and accepts order: 'worklist'; getConversations orders threads with an open human_pending sms_response_job first through server/lib/smsConversationList.ts, which falls back to lastMessageAt order when migration 0092 is absent (missing-table error through server/lib/dbErrors.ts). Final checks (lane, labels FACT): touched client and server test files through heavy.mjs green across three rounds (7 files 119 passed; 11 files 192 passed; 3 files 70 passed); full nickstire vitest 1194 files passed, 1 failed (scripts/tidbRestore.test.ts: child Node process CSPRNG abort under load, passes alone, outside the diff); pnpm run check, lint:source, lint:hooks, lint:orphans exit 0; red-first per round (27/5, 10/2, 4/33, 12/34, 9/2, 8 failed + 1 file not loading); mutations 6/6, 9/9 and 5/5 killed; contrast 5.27:1 and 10.76:1. Codex: 14 findings over 4 passes, all fixed and resolved. Owed after deploy: the first revenue_opportunities row with attempts > 0 and a receipt note of called or texted written by a human verb (0 of 1,621 on 2026-10-23), the Messages header showing the human_pending number, and Nour's look at 375 px.
